item.title: Rockies use big 5th inning to plow past Cardinals
item.description: Cole Carrigg, Adael Amador and Ezequiel Tovar had two hits apiece, and the Colorado Rockies rallied to beat the St. Louis Cardinals 10-7 in Denver on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Cole Carrigg, Adael Amador and Ezequiel Tovar had two hits apiece, and the Colorado Rockies rallied to beat the St. Louis Cardinals 10-7 in Denver on Saturday night. Brennan Bernardino (4-3) got the win and Jordan Romano picked up his 15th save for Colorado (55-87). Joshua Baez and Ivan Herrera homered and finished with two hits each for St. Louis, which lost ground in the National League wild-card chase. The Cardinals (71-72) are four games behind Arizona for the final NL playoff spot. Thomas Saggese and Leo Bernal also had two hits apiece for St. Louis. Cardinals starter Matthew Liberatore retired the first 10 batters before walking Connor Norby with one out in the fourth. He got Hunter Goodman to pop out to first and TJ Rumfield on a grounder to third to end the inning. With St. Louis leading 3-0, things unraveled in the fifth inning. Carrigg's leadoff single was Colorado's first hit, and three straight one-out singles cut the deficit to 3-2. Liberatore uncorked two wild pitches against Jake McCarthy, the second for a walk, allowing Amador to score the tying run. Luis Gastelum entered but couldn't stop the onslaught, as Tovar scored on a double steal and Norby singled to drive in McCarthy. Norby scored on Rumfield's bloop double to center to make it 6-3. Liberatore (5-14) allowed five runs on four hits in 4 1/3 innings and lost his eighth consecutive decision. He has not won since July 11th, a stretch of nine starts. St. Louis got two back in the sixth on Nolan Gorman's RBI double and a sacrifice fly by Saggese. Colorado responded in the seventh inning on Goodman's two-run single and Carrigg's run-scoring single. Goodman raced home from third on Zac Veen's squeeze bunt to cap the four-run inning. Jose Fermin had an RBI double and Herrera added a run-scoring single in the ninth before Romano recorded the final two outs. Baez's solo homer in the second and Herrera's two-run homer in the fifth, his 16th, gave the Cardinals a 3-0 lead. Rockies starter Mason Adams left after giving up a single to Alec Burleson. He allowed three runs on eight hits and struck out seven in 4 2/3 innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: Messi sets up Miami goal in first game since Argentina retirement
item.description: Lionel Messi provided an assist in Inter Miami's 2-2 draw with Atlanta United in Florida on Saturday in the Argentine's first appearance since retiring from international duty earlier this week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lionel Messi provided an assist in Inter Miami's 2-2 draw with Atlanta United in Florida on Saturday in the Argentine's first appearance since [USN:L6N44S0US TEXT:"retiring from international "]duty earlier this week. Messi, who captained Argentina to World Cup glory in 2022 and a runners-up finish in 2026, started for Miami in a match that kicked off more than 90 minutes late due to heavy rain and lightning. The 39-year-old whipped in a corner that midfielder Casemiro headed past Atlanta goalkeeper Lucas Hoyos to put Miami ahead in the 32nd minute. Miami's lead lasted only three minutes, however, as a sliding Casemiro blocked a cross that bounced off his keeper Dayne St. Clair and landed at the feet of Atlanta's Miguel Almiron, who guided it home to level. Luis Suarez restored Miami's lead just before halftime, only for Breel Embolo to convert an 87th-minute penalty and earn Atlanta a point. Messi, who scored four goals and set up another in last weekend's [USN:L4N44R00D TEXT:"7-1 rout of CF Montreal"], is joint top of the MLS scoring charts with 18 goals this season. He had previously [USN:L4N44911A TEXT:"expressed doubts"] about continuing his playing career following the death of his father, Jorge, on August 8.

item.title: Diamondbacks get past Astros in 10 innings
item.description: Gabriel Moreno stroked a one-out RBI single to center field in the top of the 10th inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied to defeat the host Houston Astros 4-3 on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Gabriel Moreno stroked a one-out RBI single to center field in the top of the 10th inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied to defeat the host Houston Astros 4-3 on Saturday. The Diamondbacks (75-68) squared the three-game interleague series after Moreno plated automatic runner Ildemaro Vargas with his single off Astros reliever Bryan King (2-4). Brandyn Garcia notched his fifth save with strikeouts of Yordan Alvarez and Jose Altuve in the 10th. Isaac Paredes singled in consecutive at-bats -- the first to give the Astros (73-70) a 2-0 lead in the third and the second to rebuild that two-run margin with a two-out hit in the fifth. Paredes' two-run, opposite-field single to right in the third scored Yainer Diaz and Taylor Trammell. It came after Arizona right-hander Brandon Pfaadt appeared on the verge of escaping that inning unscathed by retiring Cam Smith and Jeremy Pena after Trammell pushed Diaz to third with his double to right. Pfaadt allowed three runs on seven hits and two walks with four strikeouts over 6 1/3 innings. Jonathan Loaisiga (7-3) pitched a scoreless ninth and was credited with the win. The Diamondbacks began to claw back in the fifth when Tim Tawa and Lars Nootbaar sandwiched singles around a Ryan Waldschmidt groundout. Nootbaar's single chased Astros rookie right-hander Ethan Pecko and advanced Tawa to third with the first of his two hits, and Geraldo Perdomo followed with a sacrifice fly to center off Enyel De Los Santos that plated Tawa and sliced the deficit to 2-1. Pecko gave up one run on five hits and one walk with two strikeouts over 4 1/3 innings. After the Astros reclaimed their two-run lead in the bottom of the fifth on Paredes' bloop single to center that scored Pena, the Diamondbacks rallied again in the seventh, this time against Kai-Wei Teng. Tawa and Waldschmidt worked successive one-out walks that prompted another pitching change for the Astros. AJ Blubaugh entered and immediately surrendered an RBI double to Nootbaar that cut the lead to 3-2, and in the top of the eighth, the Diamondbacks pulled even when Ketel Marte worked his way out of an 0-2 hole and socked a leadoff homer to right field. Marte drilled his 22nd home run, bashing a 3-2 sweeper 388 feet. Blubaugh allowed two hits over his 1 2/3 innings of relief, but both resulted in Arizona runs. --Field Level Media

item.title: Jovic puts friendship with Eala on hold to win three-hour battle at US Open
item.description: Home hope Iva Jovic and Alexandra Eala of the Philippines put their friendship aside for three hours at the U.S. Open on Saturday before the 18-year-old American prevailed 7-5 3-6 7-5 at Arthur Ashe Stadium to reach the fourth round.
item.dc:creator: Janina Rios
item.content:encoded: Home hope Iva Jovic and Alexandra Eala of the Philippines put their friendship aside for three hours at the U.S. Open on Saturday before the 18-year-old American prevailed 7-5 3-6 7-5 at Arthur Ashe Stadium to reach the fourth round. The two rising stars and close friends had already shared the court in New York during Fan Week when they teamed up with their fathers for a light-hearted doubles hit. There was little room for sentiment once the match began on Saturday, however. Jovic edged a tight opening set but Eala responded in the second, the 21-year-old raising her level to force a decider. The final set again featured momentum swings, with Jovic trailing 4-2 before fighting back to close out the victory and extend her head-to-head record against Eala to 3-0, with a win on each of the three surfaces. "That felt like a marathon. I felt like I lost my sanity five times over to win that match. But it's really worth it for this feeling," Jovic said on court. "I'm usually not one that shows that many emotions. But this one really meant a lot to me. It's everything to have another match at the U.S. Open." Jovic's victory was a welcome bright spot on a difficult day for American tennis, with Taylor Fritz, Madison Keys and Amanda Anisimova among the home players eliminated. Ranked a career-high 14th, Jovic had never gone beyond the second round in two previous U.S. Open appearances but she has now reached the last 16 at three Grand Slams this season. Her victory sets up an all-American fourth-round clash with fourth seed Coco Gauff, who advanced earlier on Saturday by beating Spain's Cristina Bucsa.

item.title: Cincinnati-D.C. United match postponed due to inclement weather

item.content:encoded: An MLS match between visiting D.C. United and FC Cincinnati was postponed on Saturday night because of inclement weather. After a lightning delay of more than 2 hours and 45 minutes, the match was called off, with the following message flashed on the scoreboard. item.title: Timely hitting, solid pitching lift Yankees past Padres
item.description: Cody Bellinger's two-run single capped a four-run second inning and Carlos Rodon threw five solid innings as the visiting New York Yankees knocked off the San Diego Padres 5-1 on Saturday.

item.content:encoded: Cody Bellinger's two-run single capped a four-run second inning and Carlos Rodon threw five solid innings as the visiting New York Yankees knocked off the San Diego Padres 5-1 on Saturday. It stayed within four games of Tampa Bay in the American League East and maintained a 3 1/2-game lead over the Boston Red Sox for the AL's first wild-card spot. The Diamondbacks (75-68) edged the host Houston Astros 4-3 in 10 innings on Saturday night. Ray sailed through the first inning on just eight pitches but found trouble in the second. Ben Rice, who collected three singles and two walks, singled to start the inning and moved up to second on a groundout by George Lombard Jr. Spencer Jones laced a two-out double to the right field corner that cashed in Rice. Then Ray lost the strike zone, issuing walks to Jose Cabellero, Austin Wells and Paul Goldschmidt, with Goldschmidt earning an RBI. Bellinger then made it 4-0 with his single to right. New York scored its final run in the third when Rice walked and Heliot Ramos singled him to third prior to Lombard's sacrifice fly that scored Rice. Manny Machado accounted for San Diego's only run when he launched his 25th homer of the year to lead off the fourth. The 391-foot blast gave him at least 25 homers in 11 straight seasons (not including the COVID-shortened 2020 campaign), the longest current streak of its kind in the majors. It was one of just three hits for the Padres. --Field Level Media

item.title: San Lorenzo vence a Talleres y vuelve al triunfo en liga argentina
item.description: San Lorenzo venció el sábado por 1-0 a Talleres de Córdoba y volvió al triunfo en el debut del director técnico provisorio Walter Perazzo, en una jornada en la cual Boca Juniors empató por 2-2 con Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: San Lorenzo venció el sábado por 1-0 a Talleres de Córdoba y volvió al triunfo en el debut del director técnico provisorio Walter Perazzo, en una jornada en la cual Boca Juniors empató por 2-2 con Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza. San Lorenzo, que días atrás quedó sin entrenador por el despido de Néstor Gorosito, se recuperó de dos partidos sin ganar y sumó la tercera victoria en la competencia. "Me encontré con un plantel golpeado que necesitaba un poco de cariño y los jugadores en estos días transmitían ganas de poder salir adelante", dijo Perazzo en conferencia de prensa. En el partido, correspondiente a la octava jornada del torneo Clausura disputado en el estadio Pedro Bidegain, el gol del triunfo lo anotó a los 63 minutos Alexis Cuello a través de un remate de cabeza. Talleres quedó con un hombre menos a los 58 minutos por la expulsión de Matías Galarza. Por su parte, Boca Juniors dejó escapar la victoria e igualó por 2-2 en su visita a Gimnasia y Esgrima después de estar dos veces en ventaja en el estadio Víctor Antonio Legrotaglie del Parque San Martín, en la provincia de Mendoza. "No podemos perder dos puntos importantes en los últimos dos minutos. Hay que ganar", dijo en conferencia de prensa el director técnico de Boca Juniors, Rodolfo Arruabarrena. Los goles de Boca Juniors los anotaron Alan Velasco y Kevin Zenón a los 17 y 38 minutos, mientras que para Gimnasia convirtieron Ignacio Sabatini y Esteban Fernández a los 19 y 94, respectivamente. “Nos vamos re calientes porque nos tendríamos que haber llevado la victoria, esa es la sensación. Este empate no suma", dijo Velasco a la televisión local. En otros partidos del sábado, Vélez Sarsfield venció por 1-0 a Estudiantes de La Plata, Aldosivi ganó por 3-1 a Banfield, y Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata derrotó por 2-1 a Tigre. El viernes, Sarmiento venció 2-0 a Estudiantes de Río Cuarto, mientras que los partidos entre Belgrano-Huracán y Platense-Deportivo Riestra finalizaron igualados en un gol.

item.title: Ryan Jeffers' 3-run blast helps Twins sink White Sox
item.description: Ryan Jeffers belted a three-run homer, and the Minnesota Twins held on for a 6-4 win over the host Chicago White Sox on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Ryan Jeffers belted a three-run homer, and the Minnesota Twins held on for a 6-4 win over the host Chicago White Sox on Saturday night. Kaelen Culpepper went 2-for-5 with a double and an RBI for Minnesota (68-74), which evened the three-game series at one win apiece with the rubber match set for Sunday. Kody Clemens and Brooks Lee added one RBI apiece. Munetaka Murakami hit a two-run homer to lead Chicago (74-68). Colson Montgomery added a solo home run, and Miguel Vargas drove in a run. Twins right-hander Taj Bradley (11-6) allowed four runs on four hits in five innings. He walked two and struck out six. White Sox left-hander Anthony Kay (9-8) gave up five runs on six hits in 4 1/3 innings. He walked one and fanned three. Twins right-hander Yoendrys Gomez pitched a scoreless ninth for his 21st save. The White Sox wasted no time jumping to a 3-0 lead in the bottom of the first. Sam Antonacci drew a leadoff walk, and two batters later Murakami belted an opposite-field homer over the wall in left field to make it 2-0. It was the 30th homer for Murakami, who arrived in the majors this season after a standout career in Japan. Montgomery made it a three-run lead later in the inning with a homer to right. It marked his 31st homer of the season and his second in as many nights. The Twins cut the deficit to 3-2 in the fourth. Clemens grounded into an RBI fielder's choice, and Lee delivered moments later with an RBI double to left. One inning later, the Twins seized a 5-3 advantage. Ryan Kreidler was hit by a pitch, Luke Keaschall singled and one out later, Jeffers took advantage with a three-run homer to left. The 415-foot shot gave Jeffers four home runs in his past five games. Chicago pulled within 5-4 in the bottom of the fifth. Chase Meidroth singled to center, stole second base and scored on a two-out single by Vargas to left. The Twins increased their lead to 6-4 on Culpepper's RBI double in the seventh. -Field Level Media

item.title: Sonny Gray twirls 7 scoreless as Red Sox blank Orioles
item.description: Sonny Gray pitched seven scoreless innings to earn his major league-leading 17th win as the visiting Boston Red Sox defeated the Baltimore Orioles 5-0 on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Sonny Gray pitched seven scoreless innings to earn his major league-leading 17th win as the visiting Boston Red Sox defeated the Baltimore Orioles 5-0 on Saturday night. The Red Sox (78-65) have won the first three games of the four-game series. The Orioles (69-74) have lost five straight. Eli White and Isiah Kiner-Falefa each drove in two runs. Trevor Story collected three hits and scored two runs and Nick Sogard had two hits for the Red Sox. Gray (17-4), who was facing Baltimore for the first time this season, held the Orioles to three hits and three walks while striking out seven. Jovani Moran, Greg Weissert and Wyatt Olds worked in relief to complete the five-hit shutout. Baltimore struck out 10 times, and three of its five hits were doubles. Chris Bassitt (6-5) matched Gray until he ran into trouble in the sixth inning. He went 5 2/3 innings and was charged with three runs on five hits and four walks. The pitchers' duel marked a second consecutive shutout for the Red Sox, who won 1-0 on Friday night. White's two-out, two-run single opened the scoring in the sixth. Connor Wong followed with an RBI single to make it 3-0. Boston, which pulled out one-run victories in the first two games of the series, stretched its lead in the seventh on Kiner-Falefa's two-out double that pushed across two more runs. The teams combined for five hits through five innings. The Orioles threatened in the third after Colton Cowser's leadoff double. He advanced to third on Jackson Holliday's lineout to right but was thrown out at home on Blaze Alexander's fielder's-choice grounder. Baltimore, which was held to six singles Friday, stranded two runners in the first inning. --Field Level Media

item.title: Jonathan Aranda powers Rays past Rangers in 10th inning
item.description: Jonathan Aranda blasted a three-run homer in the 10th inning to lift the Tampa Bay Rays to a 6-3 win against the Texas Rangers on Saturday evening in Arlington, Texas.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jonathan Aranda blasted a three-run homer in the 10th inning to lift the Tampa Bay Rays to a 6-3 win against the Texas Rangers on Saturday evening in Arlington, Texas. The Rays had runners on the corners with one out off closer Jacob Latz (3-2) when Aranda lifted a two-strike slider over the fence in right-center field for a 6-3 lead. Junior Caminero and Richie Palacios also homered in the third game of the four-game series, and Liam Hicks had two hits and an RBI for Tampa Bay (85-57), which has won two in a row. Tampa Bay starter Drew Rasmussen limited the Rangers to one run and three hits over seven innings. The right-hander struck out seven and didn't walk a batter. Tyler Wells (4-2) pitched a scoreless ninth and 10th to earn the win. Rangers right-hander Jacob deGrom allowed two runs and four hits over six innings. He struck out seven and walked one. Joc Pederson and Evan Carter homered for the Rangers (70-73), who have lost three of four. Caminero came up with two outs in the first and homered over the left-center field fence to give the Rays a 1-0 lead. It was his 38th home run of the season, taking over the American League lead. In the fifth, deGrom got two quick outs before Palacios turned on a 2-0 sinker and pulled it over the fence in right for a home run that made it 2-0. Palacios also homered in a 7-6 win against the Rangers on Friday night. Rasmussen mostly cruised through the first five innings before Pederson dinged him with one out in the sixth, pulling a 79-mph first-pitch curveball just inside the right field foul pole to cut it to 2-1. The Rays rallied with two outs in the eighth off Jakob Junis, getting three straight singles from Aranda, Caminero and Hicks to extend the lead to 3-1. Carter got a run back in the bottom half of the inning when he greeted reliever Kevin Kelly with a leadoff home run to cut it to 3-2. The inning continued with a one-out single from Danny Jansen. Pinch runner Cam Cauley scored from first when pinch hitter Justin Foscue doubled into the left-center-field gap off reliever Cam Booser to tie it 3-3. --Field Level Media

item.title: Blue Jays top Royals, over .500 for first time in 5 months
item.description: Kazuma Okamoto's fourth hit of the night was a tiebreaking, seventh-inning RBI single, and the Toronto Blue Jays made it hold to win their fourth straight, 4-3 over the host Kansas City Royals on Saturday to move above .500 for the first time since early April.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kazuma Okamoto's fourth hit of the night was a tiebreaking, seventh-inning RBI single, and the Toronto Blue Jays made it hold to win their fourth straight, 4-3 over the host Kansas City Royals on Saturday to move above .500 for the first time since early April. With the game tied 3-3, Kansas City's Craig Kimbrel (1-3) walked George Springer, who then stole second base. With two outs, Nathan Lukes grounded to shortstop Bobby Witt Jr., whose throw pulled first baseman Vinnie Pasquantino off the bag to extend the inning. Okamoto then grounded a single to center, bringing home Springer. The Royals (63-80) put runners on first and second with nobody out in the eighth against Tyler Rogers, but Pasquantino bounced into a 1-6-3 double play and Michael Massey then grounded out to first. Louis Varland pitched a scoreless ninth for his 33rd save as the Blue Jays (72-71), who have a winning record for the first time since sitting at 4-3 on April 3, moved into a tie with the Cleveland Guardians for the final American League wild-card spot. Okamoto drove in two runs and Lukes had three hits with an RBI while Mason Fluharty (6-1) threw a scoreless inning to get the win. Meanwhile, Toronto starter Max Scherzer allowed three runs over 5 2/3 innings. Kansas City's Seth Lugo gave up three runs on eight hits and two walks over five innings. He struck out one. Salvador Perez had two hits with an RBI and John Rave homered for the Royals, who have lost five of six. Toronto opened the scoring with two outs in the first. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. singled then scored from first base on Alejandro Kirk's infield hit coupled with third baseman Josh Rojas' throwing error. Lukes then followed with an RBI single to left. The Royals answered in the bottom of the frame. Scherzer hit leadoff batter Carter Jensen, then Witt doubled to left. Jac Caglianone and Perez followed with RBI singles to tie the contest. Toronto regained the lead in the third when Lukes singled and scored from first on Okamoto's double off the third base bag. But the Royals tied it again, this time on Rave's homer just inside the right field foul pole in the fourth. Caglianone exited in the third inning due to left elbow soreness. --Field Level Media

item.title: From boardroom chic to battling win, Osaka reaches US Open last 16
item.description: Naomi Osaka continued to impress with her style and staying power at the U.S. Open on Saturday as the Japanese 13th seed shrugged off a late Achilles problem to beat Belgian Elise Mertens 6-3 3-6 7-5 and reach the fourth round.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Naomi Osaka continued to impress with her style and staying power at the U.S. Open on Saturday as the Japanese 13th seed shrugged off a late Achilles problem to beat Belgian Elise Mertens 6-3 3-6 7-5 and reach the fourth round. For her latest eye-catching [USN:L4N44T05M TEXT:"walk-on"] look, the four-times major champion blended boardroom and locker-room aesthetics in a grey checked blazer-hoodie and wide-leg pants, putting a tailored twist on traditional pre-match attire. She looked on course for a business-like win after the first set but was dragged into a battle in the third, where she had to fight through the Achilles niggle to advance. "I wouldn't say it's a huge injury," Osaka told reporters. "I'd say it's this ongoing problem that I've had since the grass season. "I don't know why it hasn't gone away. I feel I've done a lot of things in order to make it better, but maybe the time off wasn't enough. I'm not really sure what the reason is, but the medical timeout was to address that. "You know, she massaged my leg and stuff, so that seemed to help, and gave me Tylenol." The 28-year-old, a two-times champion at Flushing Meadows, reeled off three games in succession to take a 4-1 lead in the first set under the lights of Louis Armstrong Stadium, clinching it with a battling hold thanks to a string of booming serves. Osaka pushed the 23rd seed hard at the start of the next set with some heavy hitting from the baseline before pouncing with a break in the third game, only to surrender the lead by dropping the next two games. "Honestly, I can't believe I won this match," Osaka said on court after sealing victory, thanking the crowd for the energy they provided. "There was a certain point where I put my heart on the court and kept trying in every point. Thank you so much, but honestly, I'm shocked I won. I'm not going to lie." After levelling the match to force a decider, Mertens capitalised on several unforced errors by a frustrated Osaka to gain the upper hand, but there would be another momentum shift in the match after a medical timeout for the Japanese player. "I didn't play amazing and it was getting me down, sorry about my behaviour, for the little kids watching," said Osaka, who threw her racket to the floor at one point. "This is my favourite tournament. I wanted to play well in front of you. I'm just that glad I have the opportunity to play another match. "I thought I was going to be ok, but clearly I was shaky." After recovering a break late on, Osaka fired a huge ace to take a 6-5 lead and revved up her forehand in the following game to complete the win and earn a meeting with Elena Rybakina in the next round.

item.title: Rockies place ailing Willi Castro (heel) on IL
item.description: The Colorado Rockies placed infielder/outfielder Willi Castro on the 10-day injured list Saturday due to left heel inflammation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Colorado Rockies placed infielder/outfielder Willi Castro on the 10-day injured list Saturday due to left heel inflammation. The move is retroactive to Wednesday. Castro, 29, has been dealing with plantar fasciitis and hasn't played since Monday against the Baltimore Orioles. Castro has smacked a career-high 15 homers while batting .260 with 56 RBIs in 120 games this season. The versatile Castro has started 51 games at second base and 36 at third. He also has 15 starts at shortstop, six at first base and two in left field. Castro has a .247 career average with 71 homers and 284 RBIs in 825 games with the Detroit Tigers (2019-22). Minnesota Twins (2023-25), Chicago Cubs (2025) and Rockies. He was an American League All-Star in 2024 for the Twins. Colorado selected the contract of infielder Vimael Machin from Triple-A Albuquerque in a corresponding move. This is the first stint in the majors this season for Machin, who turns 33 on Sept. 25. He has a .204 career average with two homers and 15 RBIs in 116 games with the Athletics (2020-22) and Orioles (2025). Colorado also outrighted outfielder Tyler Freeman to Albuquerque after he cleared waivers to open up a 40-man roster spot for Machin. Freeman, 27, batted .247 with three homers and 23 RBIs in 79 games for the Rockies this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Yusei Kikuchi tosses 6 scoreless as Angels beat Pirates
item.description: Yusei Kikuchi pitched six scoreless innings for his first win of the season and Josh Lowe hit a home run to lead the visiting Los Angeles Angels to a 6-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Yusei Kikuchi pitched six scoreless innings for his first win of the season and Josh Lowe hit a home run to lead the visiting Los Angeles Angels to a 6-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday night. Wade Meckler doubled twice and had two RBIs, Zach Neto went 3-for-5 with an RBI and Mike Trout added two hits and an RBI for Los Angeles (54-88), which snapped a three-game losing streak. Making just his 10th start of the season after missing almost four months with left shoulder inflammation, Kikuchi (1-5) allowed five hits, walked three and struck out six to pick up his first win since Sept. 24, 2025, against Kansas City. Bryan Reynolds went 3-for-3 with a home run and a walk and Rafael Flores Jr. had two hits, including a double, for Pittsburgh (70-73). Braxton Ashcraft (14-6) took the loss after allowing three runs on seven hits in five innings. He struck out nine, threw a wild pitch and did not issue a walk. Los Angeles took a 1-0 lead in the fourth inning when Meckler doubled down the left-field line and scored one out later on a single by Moises Ballesteros. The Angels extended the lead to 3-0 in the fifth inning. Lowe led off the frame with his 11th home run, a 410-foot blast to straightaway center. Denzer Guzman followed with a single, advanced to second on a sacrifice bunt, took third on a balk and scored on Neto's single to center. Los Angeles broke the game open with three runs in the seventh inning off reliever Isaac Mattson. Adam Frazier doubled with one out and went to third on a single by Neto. Trout followed with an RBI single and Meckler then lined a double into the alley in right-center to drive in both Neto and Trout. Reynolds ended the shutout with two outs in the bottom of the eighth when he clubbed his 16th home run of the season, a 421-foot drive over the bleachers in right field. --Field Level Media

item.title: Tyler Reddick starts Chase from pole at Darlington after qualifying canceled
item.description: DARLINGTON, S.C. -- Inclement weather forced the cancellation of Busch Light pole qualifying at Darlington (S.C.) Raceway on Saturday evening, and no one was happier about the development than 23XI Racing's Tyler Reddick, who will now lead the field to green in the Cook Out Southern 500 to open The Chase on Sunday night (5 p.m. ET, USA Network, MRN, SiriusXM NASCAR Radio).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: DARLINGTON, S.C. -- Inclement weather forced the cancellation of Busch Light pole qualifying at Darlington (S.C.) Raceway on Saturday evening, and no one was happier about the development than 23XI Racing's Tyler Reddick, who will now lead the field to green in the Cook Out Southern 500 to open The Chase on Sunday night (5 p.m. ET, USA Network, MRN, SiriusXM NASCAR Radio). This is the eighth time this season the five-time NASCAR Cup Series race winner and driver of the No. 45 Toyota will start from the No. 1 position on the grid -- five times through a formal qualifying session and three others as a result of a canceled session due to weather. "This is literally the best-case scenario for us," said a smiling Reddick, who has now started among the top 10 at every Darlington race throughout his entire four-year career at 23XI Racing. Reddick led 77 of the 293 laps and won from pole position here in March. "We were so strong here in the spring," he said. "Ironically enough, as I kind of got going in Cup racing, it was during COVID with no practice at all and I got very used to just having to figure it out in the first corner. "So for me, generally, I feel like we're in a really good spot most weekends when this happens. But beyond that, as strong as we were, I know teams may want to try things to close the gap, but no one had that opportunity today, so that helps us even more." Reddick will share the front row with fellow title contender Daniel Suarez in the No. 7 Spire Motorsports Chevrolet. Chase drivers, Roush Fenway Keselowski's Ryan Preece and championship leader Denny Hamlin of Joe Gibbs Racing, will roll off third and fourth. Hamlin, whose five career Darlington wins are the most in the field, won the regular-season title and starts the race with a 25-point advantage on the next-closest competitor in the 16-driver championship field. Spire Motorsports' Michael McDowell, who is not championship-eligible, will start fifth. He is followed by a pair of Chase drivers, Team Penske's Austin Cindric and JGR's Chase Briscoe, who is the two-time defending race winner and the only other multi-time winner among the field. Three non-Chase drivers -- HYAK Motorsports' Ricky Stenhouse Jr., Richard Childress Racing's Austin Dillon, and Hendrick Motorsports' Alex Bowman -- round out the top 10 on the grid. The rainout performance metric has made for an interesting challenge for several of the other Chase drivers. JGR's Christopher Bell starts 11th with Penske's Joey Logano -- a three-time series champion -- 13th on the grid. item.title: Athletics place RHP J.T. Ginn (elbow) on 15-day injured list
item.description: The Athletics placed starting pitcher J.T. Ginn on the 15-day injured list on Saturday because of a right elbow impingement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Athletics placed starting pitcher J.T. Ginn on the 15-day injured list on Saturday because of a right elbow impingement. The right-hander is eligible to come off the injured list on Sept. 20, but the Athletics haven't yet made a determination about whether he will pitch again this season. In a corresponding move, the Athletics recalled right-hander Jack Perkins from Triple-A Las Vegas one day after optioning him to the affiliate. In other moves on Saturday, the team recalled right-hander Seth Johnson from Las Vegas and optioned rookie righty Kade Morris to Triple A. Ginn, 27, last pitched on Aug. 26, earning the win after going six innings and allowing four runs, six hits (including three home runs) and two walks with three strikeouts in the 7-4 home victory over the Minnesota Twins. The Athletics flew in an orthopedist on Saturday to evaluate Ginn for what was described as general fatigue/soreness. "We'll make a determination (Saturday) as to his future," Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said Friday. "You always want guys to finish the season, but we need to make the right decision for him going forward and his future, especially going into next year." Ginn is 9-8 with a 3.71 ERA, 57 walks and 121 strikeouts in a career-high 138 1/3 innings over 27 games (24 starts) this season. He has a career mark of 14-16 with a 4.25 ERA, 97 walks and 249 strikeouts in 58 games (46 starts) over parts of the last three seasons with the Athletics. Perkins, 26, is 3-10 with a 6.50 ERA, three saves, 47 walks and 116 strikeouts in 98 1/3 innings over 33 games (13 starts) this season. He made his major league debut in 2025 and is a career 6-12 with a 5.85 ERA, six saves, 65 walks and 153 strikeouts in 137 innings over 45 games (17 starts). Johnson, who turns 28 on Sept. 19, is 0-0 with a 13.50 ERA in 4 2/3 innings over five relief appearances with the Athletics since he was traded from the Philadelphia Phillies on Aug. 3 for outfielder Colby Thomas. Johnson was 1-0 with a 5.51 ERA in 16 1/3 innings over 16 relief appearances with the Phillies. Morris, 24, was 0-1 with a 10.90 ERA, seven walks and 10 strikeouts in 17 1/3 innings over six games (two starts) for the Athletics. He started Friday's 7-6 win at Seattle and allowed five runs on five hits and one walk in 2 2/3 innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: Indonésie-L'aéroport de Djakarta suspend les vols en raison de l'éruption de l'Anak Krakatau
item.description: Les vols aériens ont été suspendus dimanche matin au principal aéroport de Djakarta, en Indonésie, en raison des cendres volcaniques rejetées par le volcan Anak Krakatau, entré en éruption vendredi soir.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les vols aériens ont été suspendus dimanche matin au principal aéroport de Djakarta, en Indonésie, en raison des cendres volcaniques rejetées par le volcan Anak Krakatau, entré en éruption vendredi soir. L'aéroport Soekarno-Hatta a fait savoir sur le réseau social Instagram que les vols aériens seraient suspendus jusqu'à 09h30 heure locale (02h30 GMT). Quelque 209 vols, dont plusieurs internationaux, ont été affectés, a déclaré le ministère indonésien des Transports. Des nuages de cendres volcaniques ont perturbé les activités dans les provinces de Lampung, sur l'île de Sumatra, et de Banten, sur l'île de Java, a dit un porte-parole de l'agence nationale de gestion des catastrophes (BNPB). Selon la BNPB, il n'existe aucun risque de tsunami dans l'immédiat.

item.content:encoded: Guadalajara, el club más popular del fútbol mexicano, goleó el sábado por 3-0 como visitante al Atlético de San Luis y se ubicó en el subliderato del torneo Apertura. Con su cuarto triunfo, las "Chivas" de Guadalajara subieron del quinto al segundo lugar general con 14 puntos, dos menos que el líder América. En el partido disputado en el estadio Libertad Financiera de San Luis, el llamado "Rebaño Sagrado" se adelantó a los seis minutos cuando el guardameta Andrés Sánchez metió el balón a su propia portería tras pegarle en la espalda después de que Santiago Sandoval estrelló su remate en el poste derecho. Tres minutos después, el equipo visitante aumentó su ventaja con un disparo de zurda de Ricardo Marín en el centro del área tras un pase de cabeza de Ángel Sepúlveda. El tercer gol de Guadalajara cayó a los 80 minutos por conducto de Richard Ledezma, quien definió con un potente disparo cruzado dentro del área. "Hicimos un partido muy bueno, con una intensidad muy alta, pudimos marcar dos goles en los primeros 10 minutos, que eso ayuda para el desarrollo del partido. Los chicos lo hicieron muy bien en lo ofensivo y en lo defensivo, muchas ganas de ganar, nos vamos con una victoria de una cancha difícil", dijo en conferencia de prensa el director técnico de Guadalajara, el argentino Gabriel Milito. "Siempre es importante empezar ganando, la voluntad siempre es la misma: pensar en el arco rival y ser un equipo valiente. A veces los rivales crean dificultades, pero el partido de hoy fue muy completo", agregó. En los otros partidos del sábado, Tigres UANL y Necaxa empataron por 1-1 con goles del uruguayo Rodrigo Aguirre y Owen González, respectivamente. Atlas y Atlante también igualaron por 1-1 con tantos del portugués Luis Esteves y del argentino Martín Sarrafiore, respectivamente. El domingo, el vigente campeón Cruz Azul enfrentará a Santos Laguna. Los encuentros entre Pumas UNAM-León, Puebla-Toluca, América-Tijuana y Querétaro-Monterrey se pospusieron debido a la participación de América, Toluca, León y Monterrey en la Leagues Cup. En el inicio de la jornada, Pachuca venció el viernes por 2-0 como visitante a Bravos de Ciudad Juárez en el debut del argentino Gustavo Lema como director técnico del equipo derrotado.

item.title: Shohei Ohtani out of Dodgers' starting lineup for 3rd straight game
item.description: Shohei Ohtani was out of the Los Angeles Dodgers' starting lineup for the third consecutive game Saturday as he continues to deal with lingering issues involving his neck, right biceps and left knee.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shohei Ohtani was out of the Los Angeles Dodgers' starting lineup for the third consecutive game Saturday as he continues to deal with lingering issues involving his neck, right biceps and left knee. The superstar two-way player sat out of the Dodgers' 3-2 win on Thursday against the St. Louis Cardinals and their 5-3 win on Friday over the Washington Nationals. Ohtani, a four-time MVP, was scheduled to hit in the batting cages Saturday prior to Los Angeles' home game against the Washington Nationals, manager Dave Roberts said. How Ohtani feels afterward could determine whether the six-time All-Star ends up on the injured list. "If it doesn't feel good today," Roberts said, "then (the IL) certainly should be on the table." The 32-year-old Ohtani is batting .279 this season with 30 home runs and 80 RBIs. He is hitting just .137 (7 for 51) with one home run over his past 13 games amid the physical issues. Ohtani is 8-2 with a 1.79 ERA and 95 strikeouts in 85 2/3 innings across 14 starts this season. He has not pitched since July 3, and he has declined to speak to the media since Aug. 17. The minimum stint on the injured list for a two-way player is 15 days, the same as it is for pitchers. --Field Level Media

item.title: Riley Greene smacks two HRs to help Tigers defeat Guardians
item.description: All-Star outfielder Riley Greene had four RBIs in his ninth career multi-homer game as the visiting Detroit Tigers bounced back from a doubleheader sweep, beating the Cleveland Guardians 6-0 on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: All-Star outfielder Riley Greene had four RBIs in his ninth career multi-homer game as the visiting Detroit Tigers bounced back from a doubleheader sweep, beating the Cleveland Guardians 6-0 on Saturday night. Framber Valdez (9-10) pitched seven scoreless innings, matching his season high, and allowed three hits. The left-hander struck out three, walked one and hit a batter in shutting down American League playoff-hopeful Cleveland (72-71). The Guardians are now tied with Toronto for the final wild-card berth after the Blue Jays beat the Kansas City Royals 4-3 later in the day, while Detroit (65-77) moved within 6 1/2 games of the spot. Greene hit two solo home runs against Parker Messick (11-9), a 407-foot drive in the first and a 421-foot blast in the sixth, breaking a homer drought that lasted more than a month. His previous homer occurred on Aug. 4 against the Seattle Mariners. Greene also scored three times. He delivered an RBI single in the third and an RBI double in the seventh, with Gleyber Torres scoring on both hits. All-Star rookie Messick had a career-high 12 strikeouts over six innings and allowed three runs on seven hits and two walks. Cleveland's Austin Peterson made his major league debut with two scoreless innings of relief. Dillon Dingler added a sacrifice fly later in the seventh, and Ben Malgeri collected his third hit with an RBI single that scored Greene and extended Detroit's lead to 6-0. On Friday, Cleveland won both games in walk-off fashion. Brayan Rocchio's homer in the ninth and Travis Bazzana's RBI single in the 10th did the honors, respectively. Rookie outfielder Chase DeLauter (right wrist sprain) was unavailable for the Guardians, but outfielder Angel Martinez and shortstop Rocchio were in the lineup after running into each other while pursuing a popup on Friday. Tigers third baseman Hao-Yu Lee started Saturday's game, telling manager A.J. Hinch that he was not bothered by the left shin contusion that resulted from his collision with Austin Hedges at home plate in the second game of Friday's doubleheader. --Field Level Media

item.title: Allemagne-L'AfD vise une victoire historique en Saxe-Anhalt
item.description: Les électeurs de Saxe-Anhalt sont appelés aux urnes ce dimanche pour un scrutin à l'issue duquel "Alternative pour l'Allemagne" (AfD) espère devenir le premier parti d'extrême droite à accéder au pouvoir au niveau régional dans le pays depuis la Seconde Guerre mondiale.
item.dc:creator: Miranda Murray
item.content:encoded: Les électeurs de Saxe-Anhalt sont appelés aux urnes ce dimanche pour un scrutin à l'issue duquel "Alternative pour l'Allemagne" (AfD) espère devenir le premier parti d'extrême droite à accéder au pouvoir au niveau régional dans le pays depuis la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Mené par son populaire chef de file dans ce Land de l'est de l'Allemagne, Ulrich Siegmund, âgé de 35 ans, l'AfD est crédité de plus de 40% des intentions de vote, avec une avance de 10 à 15 points sur l'Union chrétienne démocrate (CDU), au pouvoir aux côtés du Parti social-démocrate (SPD) et du Parti libéral-démocrate (FDP). Il peut espérer obtenir une majorité absolue de sièges au Parlement régional si plusieurs formations ne parviennent pas à dépasser le seuil de 5% des voix nécessaire à une représentation. Ulrich Siegmund a clamé son ambition d'obtenir au moins 45% des suffrages. Environ 1,7 million d'électeurs doivent déposer leur bulletin dans l'urne avant 18h00 (16h00 GMT). De premières estimations sont attendues rapidement après la fermeture des bureaux de vote. La participation à midi, à 34,72%, était nettement supérieure à ce qu'elle était lors des précédentes élections régionales en 2021, à 22,4%, a annoncé la commission électorale. La portée de cette élection dépasse le cadre régional en raison du soutien croissant dont jouit l'AfD au niveau national depuis sa création en 2013, sur fond d'impopularité du gouvernement dirigé par le conservateur Friedrich Merz. Obtenir une majorité absolue est un obstacle difficile à surmonter dans le système électoral allemand, conçu en partie pour favoriser les gouvernements de coalition et empêcher qu'un seul parti ne gouverne seul. L'AFD "NE PEUT PLUS ÊTRE ARRÊTÉ", DIT SIEGMUND Si l'AfD ne parvient pas à obtenir la majorité absolue et continue de se heurter à un [USN:L6N44V0RY TEXT:""cordon sanitaire""] des autres partis refusant toute alliance avec l'extrême droite, un gouvernement dirigé par la CDU, sous la houlette du ministre-président sortant Sven Schulze, est le scénario le plus probable, même si la composition exacte d'une éventuelle coalition dépendra des partis qui y participeront. Le scrutin de dimanche pourrait être suivi de plusieurs semaines de négociations alors que le SPD est crédité de moins de 10% des intentions de vote tandis que le FDP pourrait ne pas avoir d'élus faute d'atteindre les 5%. Pour l'AfD, le scrutin de dimanche est une étape décisive vers son ambition nationale, remporter les prochaines élections fédérales allemandes en 2029. "Quelle que soit l'issue du scrutin de demain, nous sommes déjà entrés dans l'histoire", a dit Ulrich Siegmund samedi soir lors d'un ultime événement de campagne. "Car ce que nous avons commencé ici en Saxe-Anhalt, ce qui est en train de se propager à travers l'Allemagne, ne peut plus être arrêté", a-t-il affirmé.

item.title: Six-time Pro Bowl S Harrison Smith returns to Vikings
item.description: Six-time Pro Bowl safety Harrison Smith agreed to return to the Minnesota Vikings for a 15th season, the team announced Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Six-time Pro Bowl safety Harrison Smith agreed to return to the Minnesota Vikings for a 15th season, the team announced Saturday. Smith, 37, had contemplated retirement in the offseason. According to reports, Smith is expected to sign a deal worth $12.25 million plus incentives that could increase his pay to $16.25 million. Smith (39 interceptions, 21.5 sacks) is one of six defensive backs in NFL history with at least 35 interceptions and 20 sacks in his career. The others are Hall of Famers Charles Woodson, Larry Wilson, Ronde Barber, LeRoy Butler and Brian Dawkins. Smith was one of the top defensive players in the second half of last decade when he earned five of his six Pro Bowl nods. His other Pro Bowl selection came in 2021. Smith has intercepted five passes in a season four times, topped 100 tackles twice and has notched three sacks on four occasions. He also had a career-best three forced fumbles in 2023. Smith has 1,180 tackles, 13 forced fumbles and 10 fumble recoveries in 207 career regular-season games (203 starts). He has 55 tackles and one sack in eight career postseason games. Last season, he had 54 tackles, two interceptions and one sack in 15 games (12 starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Zack Wheeler stifles Braves to help Phillies level series
item.description: Zack Wheeler worked six strong innings and Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-leading 41st homer as the Philadelphia Phillies topped the visiting Atlanta Braves 4-2 on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Zack Wheeler worked six strong innings and Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-leading 41st homer as the Philadelphia Phillies topped the visiting Atlanta Braves 4-2 on Saturday. Schwarber had two hits for Philadelphia, as did Bryce Harper, Derek Hill and Luis Arraez. Wheeler (12-5) struck out nine while allowing one run and three hits. The Phillies (80-62) evened the four-game series at one win apiece and moved within four games of the first-place Braves (84-58) in the National League East. Atlanta, which had won nine of its last 11, managed only five hits, including solo homers from Ronald Acuna Jr. and Austin Riley. Braves starter Martin Perez (8-9) gave up four runs, seven hits and four walks in 3 2/3 innings. The first three batters of the game reached against Wheeler, who escaped the jam by retiring the next three hitters. Philadelphia also put together a quick rally in its half of the first. After issuing back-to-back walks to open the frame, Perez retired Harper for the first out before Arraez's single made it 1-0. Perez then walked two of the next three hitters to force in another run. The veteran left-hander got out of the inning without further damage, but he ran into immediate trouble in the second. Hill led off with a triple and came home on Schwarber's groundout. Acuna's third-inning homer brought Atlanta within 3-1. However, Schwarber got that run back in the fourth with a long solo shot off Perez. Wheeler struck out the side in the fifth and then retired the Braves in order in the sixth. Riley cranked his 16th homer of the year against Jonathan Bowlan in the seventh to bring Atlanta within 4-2. Jose Alvarado took over for Philadelphia in the eighth and yielded a leadoff single to Drake Baldwin before getting a double play off the bat of Acuna. The southpaw then struck out Matt Olson to end the inning. Jhoan Duran had no issues in the ninth en route to his 30th save. --Field Level Media

item.title: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau eruption halts flights, schools, fishing
item.description: An eruption of Indonesia's Mount Anak Krakatau caused six airports to suspend flight operations on Sunday, affecting hundreds of flights at Jakarta's main airport, after some school activities and fishing were halted.
item.dc:creator: Yuddy Budiman, Bernadette Christina
item.content:encoded: An eruption of Indonesia's Mount Anak Krakatau caused six airports to suspend flight operations on Sunday, affecting hundreds of flights at Jakarta's main airport, after some school activities and fishing were halted. Soekarno-Hatta International Airport suspended flight operations until 5:30 p.m. (1030 GMT) due to volcanic ash, the airport posted on Instagram, stranding hundreds of passengers at the facility. The suspension, extended several times, has affected 301 flights, including 58 international flights, airport operator Angkasa Pura said in a statement. Singapore Airlines and Malaysia Airlines said they had cancelled flights to and from Jakarta for the rest of the day. Anak Krakatau, which is roughly halfway between Java and Sumatra in Indonesia's vast island chain, has been erupting since late on Friday, with volcanic ash detected at the airport early on Sunday, the transport ministry said. PASSENGERS STUCK AT SOEKARNO-HATTA INTERNATIONAL Ash reached as high as 20,000 feet (6,000 metres) on the Java side of the volcano and 50,000 feet (15,000 metres) on the Sumatra side and some parts of Banten province in Java, meteorological agency BMKG posted on its website. Ersy Laksita Rini, 55, was upset when she arrived at Soekarno-Hatta International and learned that her 8 a.m. flight to Surabaya had been cancelled. She said the airline had not informed her ahead of time. "If the eruption happened last night and there were predictions of flight cancellations, we should have been notified from the start," she told Reuters. "That way, passengers wouldn't have needed to come here so early and could have looked for alternatives instead." French national Eloan Tasset, 21, got a text from Batik Air that his flight to his holiday destination of Manado in North Sulawesi had been delayed, but he said it was unclear how long the delay would be. "If they tell me my flight is cancelled, I think I'm going to try to find a hotel in Jakarta," he said. The airport operator said it was providing food and light refreshments for affected passengers and buses to hotels, in coordination with the airlines. The disaster mitigation agency BNPB said it would conduct a weather modification operation, which could include cloud-seeding, on Sunday to promote rain. "If it rains heavily enough, the volcanic ash that has been disrupting our daily lives since yesterday and continuing today will be washed away quickly," BNPB chief Suharyanto told a press conference. The transport ministry named three other airports across Java — Kertajati, Ahmad Yani and Juanda — as alternatives, "should airlines or operators be able to divert their flights", said Minister Dudy Purwagandhi. FIVE INDONESIAN VOLCANOES AT ALERT LEVEL 3 BNPB "urges the public to remain calm while increasing vigilance. In the event of ashfall, people are advised to wear masks and eye protection, reduce outdoor activities, cover water sources and exercise caution when driving, as volcanic ash can reduce visibility," said spokesperson Berton Panjaitan. Ferries in Sunda Strait were operating normally, the transport ministry said, urging vessels to stay at least 3 km (2 miles) away from Anak Krakatau's crater and remain vigilant for volcanic hazards, including volcanic ash and other ejected materials. Several schools cancelled activities on Saturday after students and residents suffered eye irritations from the ash, while fishermen cancelled fishing trips, local media outlet Kompas reported. Police distributed masks to motorists in Cianjur, West Java, some 200 km (130 miles) from Anak Krakatau, the state news agency Antara reported, while the disaster management agency reported volcanic ash in the city, urging residents to stay indoors. Some 850 km (530 miles) away from Anak Krakatau, Mount Semeru in East Java also erupted on Sunday, sending an ash column 1 km (3,300 feet) above the summit, said volcano monitoring agency PVMBG. It advised residents to stay at least 5 km (3 miles) away from the crater and warned of the risk of hot ash clouds and lava flows up to 17 km (10 miles) from the summit. Indonesia sits on the Pacific "Ring of Fire", where earthquakes and volcanic eruptions are frequent. Anak Krakatau has been on alert level 3, the second-highest, since July 2. Semeru was also on level 3, as were three other volcanoes: Merapi, Lewotobi Laki-laki and Sinabung. The disaster mitigation agency said there was no imminent risk of tsunami from the volcano. A [USN:KCN1OL0P1 TEXT:"tsunami in 2018"] caused by Anak Krakatau eruptions killed more than 400 on Java and Sumatra. Anak Krakatau, which means child of Krakatau, began emerging a century ago from the area previously occupied by Krakatau, then known as Krakatoa. The older volcano destroyed itself in mass eruptions in 1883, which killed more than 36,000 people in a series of tsunamis.

item.title: Une fusée allemande décolle avec succès de Norvège
item.description: La start-up allemande Isar Aerospace a procédé samedi avec succès au lancement de sa première fusée dans l'espace depuis un pas de tir situé dans l'Arctique norvégien.
item.dc:creator: Terje Solsvik
item.content:encoded: La start-up allemande Isar Aerospace a procédé samedi avec succès au lancement de sa première fusée dans l'espace depuis un pas de tir situé dans l'Arctique norvégien. La fusée Spectrum est la première fusée commerciale à atteindre l'espace après avoir été lancée depuis l'Europe continentale. "Nous sommes en orbite! Et nous venons d'entrer dans l'histoire de l'Europe", a écrit l'entreprise dans un message publié sur le réseau social X. La ministre norvégienne de l'Industrie et du Commerce, Cecilie Myrseth, a salué le lancement de ce vol inhabité dans un communiqué. "Le fait que nous puissions désormais lancer des satellites depuis Andoeya renforce la sécurité de la Norvège et de l'Europe en ces temps tumultueux", a-t-elle dit.

item.title: Germany's AfD chases historic breakthrough as Saxony-Anhalt votes
item.description: Voting began in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday in a closely watched election that could see the Alternative for Germany (AfD) become the first far-right party to lead a state government since World War Two.
item.dc:creator: Miranda Murray
item.content:encoded: Voting began in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday in a closely watched election that could see the Alternative for Germany (AfD) become the first far-right party to lead a state government since World War Two. Under its 35-year-old lead candidate [USN:L8N44L1FP TEXT:"Ulrich Siegmund"], the AfD has polled above 40% for months and has a realistic shot at winning an absolute majority if several smaller parties fail to clear Germany's 5% hurdle to enter parliament. The exact percentage that would constitute an absolute majority will depend on how many parties overcome that hurdle, but Siegmund has said his aim is to reach 45% or more of the vote. The vote is seen as a barometer for the government of [USN:L8N43H14M TEXT:"Chancellor Friedrich Merz"], who has attempted to chip away at the AfD's popularity by taking a tougher line on [USN:L8N40I10X TEXT:"migration"] and security. About 1.7 million voters have until 6 p.m. (1600 GMT) to cast their ballot before polls close, with initial results expected shortly after. Turnout was running well above the level seen at the previous state election in 2021, with 34.72% of eligible voters having cast their ballots by noon, compared with 22.4% previously, the state election commissioner said. Recent surveys place the AfD at just over 40%, followed by Merz's Christian Democrats (CDU) at 23%. An outright majority would allow the party to sidestep Germany's political "firewall", under which mainstream parties refuse to govern with it. Achieving an absolute majority is a high bar to clear in Germany's proportional electoral system, which was designed in part to encourage coalition governments and make it difficult for one party to rule alone. If the AfD falls short, a CDU-led administration under incumbent state premier Sven Schulze is the most likely outcome, though much will depend on which smaller parties make it into parliament. The state's constitution requires the newly elected parliament to convene within 30 days of the vote, by October 6 at the latest, but there is no deadline for electing a new state premier. AFD 'CAN NO LONGER BE STOPPED' For the AfD, Saxony-Anhalt is a test run for its larger ambitions of [USN:L1N44K02T TEXT:"securing national power"] in the next federal election set for 2029. "No matter the outcome of tomorrow's election, we have already made history," said Siegmund at a final rally on Saturday evening. "Because what we have started here in Saxony-Anhalt — that is currently sweeping across all of Germany — can no longer be stopped," he told the crowd in the state capital, Magdeburg. If elected, the [USN:L8N44U0P5 TEXT:"AfD plans"] to push schools and cultural institutions towards more traditional values, curb immigration and overhaul public broadcasting. However, without an absolute majority, the AfD, which has been classified as "far-right extremist" by the state security service, would struggle to enter government due to the firewall. Siegmund, who arrived to cast his vote in his hometown of Tangermuende on [USN:L6N44G0YD TEXT:"a blue Simson moped"], greeted by throngs of excited fans, has ruled out coalition talks with other parties. Falling short of that opens the prospect of [USN:L8N44T0M3 TEXT:"complex coalition negotiation"]s among the other parties. Polls suggest one of the CDU's current coalition partners, the Free Democratic Party, will fail to enter parliament, while the other, the Social Democratic Party (SPD), is under 10%. The small left-wing populist Sahra Wagenknecht Alliance (BSW), the only party not to rule out a coalition with the AfD, risks missing out as well. That could leave Schulze, who is favoured in polls as voters' top choice for leader, scrambling for a viable majority. One option could be a minority government led by Schulze that would depend on passive tolerance from the Left Party — a model used in the neighbouring eastern German state of Thuringia. Schulze, casting his vote in Magdeburg with far fewer crowds, said he hoped for a high turnout after what he described as a physically and mentally demanding election campaign.

item.title: Michael Conforto, Ian Happ lead Cubs past Marlins
item.description: Ian Happ drove in two runs, and Michael Conforto slugged a solo homer as the Chicago Cubs defeated the host Miami Marlins 6-5 on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Ian Happ drove in two runs, and Michael Conforto slugged a solo homer as the Chicago Cubs defeated the host Miami Marlins 6-5 on Saturday. Ryan Zeferjahn got the final five outs without allowing a run to earn his first save with the Cubs and fifth of the season. Conforto's homer was the major league-leading 200th of the season for the Cubs. Griffin Conine led Miami with a two-run homer measured at 430 feet in the fifth inning. Kyle Stowers added the longest home run of his career, a 442-foot solo blast, in the seventh. Chicago (81-62) will go for a three-game sweep of the Marlins (71-72) on Sunday. Cubs starter Javier Assad allowed three runs on three hits and walked five across his 4 2/3 innings. Ryan Gusto (1-4) took the loss for Miami after allowing five runs on 10 hits and two walks in 4 2/3 innings. The right-hander had a 1.88 ERA in six August starts. Chicago threatened Gusto in the second inning as its first two batters singled. But Happ tried to go first-to-third on Nico Hoerner's single and was cut down on center fielder Jakob Marsee's one-hop throw. The inning ended when Hoerner was thrown out by catcher Joe Mack trying to steal third. The Cubs opened the scoring in the third, when Conforto launched his leadoff homer 411 feet to center. Happ added a two-run single that came off his bat at 109.7 mph. Chicago extended its lead to 4-0 in the fourth as catcher Miguel Amaya hustled his way to a double to shallow left, then scored on Pete Crow-Armstrong's two-out single to center. Miami loaded the bases with no outs in the bottom of the fourth with an Otto Lopez double sandwiched between a pair of walks. Former Cub Owen Caissie and Mack then earned RBIs on groundouts. Chicago made it 5-2 in the fifth when Michael Busch opened the frame with a double and later scored on Hoerner's two-out single that chased Gusto. Assad exited with two outs in the fifth, and Caleb Thielbar allowed Conine's two-run homer, cutting Miami's deficit to 5-4. Chicago got one back in the sixth on Busch's two-out RBI single to right. Stowers' homer in the seventh again cut Miami's deficit to one run. In the eighth, Miami's Esteury Ruiz smashed a one-out double to center. He was ultimately stranded when Deyvison De Los Santos grounded out and third baseman Alex Bregman made a nice fielding play to throw Javier Sanoja out at first to end the threat. --Field Level Media

item.title: Shorthanded Argentina hold on for 28-28 second test draw with Wallabies
item.description: Skipper Pablo Matera scored two tries as a brave Argentina effort earned them a 28-28 draw against Australia despite playing for the last 10 minutes with 13 men in the second test in Mendoza on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Skipper Pablo Matera scored two tries as a brave Argentina effort earned them a 28-28 draw against Australia despite playing for the last 10 minutes with 13 men in the second test in Mendoza on Saturday. The Wallabies will take series honours after their 27-21 win in San Salvador de Jujuy last week, and remain unbeaten in four matches under new coach Les Kiss, but will rue not finishing off a shorthanded Pumas side. Matera grabbed his second try to put the home side ahead for the first time in the 64th minute but calamity struck for the Pumas six minutes later. Lucio Cinti was shown a yellow card for a deliberate knock-on and, from the resulting penalty, referee James Doleman sent Santiago Carreras to join him in the sin bin for the same infraction while awarding Australia a penalty try to level up the scores. Australia's backline has not really fired yet under Kiss and that lack of fluency, along with a tendency towards error, cost them dearly as they chased the winning score. "It's difficult to come here and do what we did," said Kiss. "But we know we let them off the hook. We took control, then let it go. Took control again, then let it go again. "Series win, we get a trophy, but we know there's plenty we need to work on." The Wallabies had started the match well and held a 14-0 lead after scoring two tries inside half an hour at a cool and windy Estadio Malvinas Argentinas. Shortly after having a try called back for a foot in touch, recalled Australia captain Harry Wilson opened the scoring from close range in the 20th minute. Pumas lock Franco Molina was sent to the sin bin in the 27th minute and the visitors quickly took advantage of the extra man to send winger Max Jorgensen across the line after the forwards had drawn in the defence. Scrumhalf Ryan Lonergan converted both tries but the visitors were well aware they had held a similarly comfortable lead in the second test on their 2024 tour only to lose 67-27. The Pumas duly hit back with two tries in four minutes before halftime after a yellow card shown to Australia lock Jeremy Williams evened up the numbers. Matera crashed over under the posts before winger Ignacio Mendy flashed through the Australian defensive line in a well-worked move from a lineout. Fullback Santiago Carreras slotted the conversions to level up the scores and Argentina could have gone into halftime with the lead had they kicked either of the penalties they were awarded on the Australia line just before the break. Flanker Fraser McReight forced his way over the line to put Australia back ahead early in the second half but a similar converted try from Argentina hooker Ignacio Ruiz made it 21-21 with 56 minutes on the clock.

item.title: Oasis llega con estilo a Venecia mientras un documental celebra su reencuentro
item.description: Liam Gallagher levantó el puño en el aire y su hermano Noel hizo el signo de la victoria cuando las estrellas del rock de Oasis llegaron en taxi acuático al Festival de Cine de Venecia el sábado, antes del estreno de un documental que narra su exitosa gira de reencuentro.
item.dc:creator: Crispian Balmer
item.content:encoded: Liam Gallagher levantó el puño en el aire y su hermano Noel hizo el signo de la victoria cuando las estrellas del rock de Oasis llegaron en taxi acuático al Festival de Cine de Venecia el sábado, antes del estreno de un documental que narra su exitosa gira de reencuentro. Cuando un periodista de Reuters les preguntó qué se sentían al estar en Venecia, Liam respondió: "Bíblico, hombre, bíblico". Noel optó por una respuesta más italiana: "Bellissimo2. Más tarde, Liam se mostró menos impresionado por los fotógrafos que gritaban para llamar su atención. "¿A qué vienen tantos gritos? ¿Es esto lo que se hace en el Festival de Cine de Venecia? ¿Gritarle a la gente?", preguntó. APOYO DE LOS FANS Y LA RECONCILIACIÓN Oasis, la banda de Mánchester cuyos himnos ayudaron a definir los años noventa antes de que las desavenencias entre los dos hermanos la destrozaran, se reunió el año pasado para una gira por Gran Bretaña, Irlanda, América del Norte y del Sur, Asia y Australia. El documental "Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger" narra la gradual reconciliación de una de las relaciones rotas más famosas de la música a lo largo de semanas de ensayos y meses de gira. "En cierto modo, se vio cómo se producía esa reconciliación sobre el escenario ante los ojos del mundo", afirmó Dylan Southern, que dirigió la película junto a Will Lovelace. El deshielo lleva su tiempo. Cuando Liam llega a su primer ensayo, no saluda a nadie de los que le rodean y se marcha bruscamente sin despedirse. Para subrayar su animadversión mutua, Noel revela que sus respectivos hijos nunca se habían conocido antes de la gira de reencuentro, pero que rápidamente se convirtieron en grandes amigos. Al final de la película, Noel describe a Liam como "encantador", algo que admite que nunca había esperado oírse decir a sí mismo. Los realizadores afirmaron que evitaron deliberadamente interferir, manteniéndose prácticamente invisibles durante las largas sesiones de ensayo y dejando que los acontecimientos se desarrollaran con naturalidad. A medida que el rodaje se trasladaba a los estadios de conciertos, Southern explicó que el enfoque se amplió para incluir a los fans, cuyo cariño se convirtió en parte integral del acercamiento entre los hermanos. Steven Knight, autor del guion, afirmó que los realizadores no tenían forma de saber si la reunión tendría éxito, pero siempre esperaron que la historia se convirtiera en una historia de perdón. "Desde el principio, queríamos que esta fuera una película sobre la reconciliación, la redención y el perdón", afirmó, añadiendo que era poco probable que ninguno de los Gallagher expresara sus emociones abiertamente. "Son hombres británicos de clase trabajadora, así que no van a chocar las manos, ni a abrazarse, ni a llorar", señaló. Knight, que está escribiendo el guion de la próxima película de James Bond, afirmó que la historia real de la gira de Oasis resultó más cautivadora que cualquier cosa que él pudiera haber escrito. "Esto es mejor que cualquier ficción que se pudiera escribir", afirmó. Southern intervino: "Y nadie podría interpretar a Liam Gallagher excepto el propio Liam Gallagher". La película se proyecta fuera de competición en el Festival de Cine de Venecia, que se celebra hasta el 12 de septiembre.

item.title: Putin comunica a enviados EEUU Witkoff y Kushner que la situación en Ucrania es "difícil"
item.description: El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, se reunió el sábado en el Kremlin con los enviados estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner, y les dijo al inicio de las conversaciones que la situación en Ucrania es "difícil".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, se reunió el sábado en el Kremlin con los enviados estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner, y les dijo al inicio de las conversaciones que la situación en Ucrania es "difícil". Putin elogió los esfuerzos del presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, por poner fin a la guerra de cuatro años y medio en Ucrania. Trump sugirió el viernes que EEUU tenía una nueva propuesta destinada a poner fin a la guerra. No dio más detalles. "Aunque es consciente de que se enfrenta a una situación difícil, no por ello cesa en sus esfuerzos por contribuir a alcanzar un acuerdo y aportar su granito de arena a la resolución del conflicto ruso-ucraniano", afirmó Putin. Al igual que en reuniones anteriores, Putin estuvo flanqueado por su asesor de política exterior, Yuri Ushakov, y su enviado para inversiones, Kirill Dmitriev, quienes recibieron a los dos visitantes en el aeropuerto, los llevaron a un restaurante y, posteriormente, los acompañaron al Kremlin. El portavoz del Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, afirmó en un comunicado publicado en el canal del Kremlin en la aplicación de mensajería Max que Putin había ordenado al ejército no atacar Kiev durante tres días, a partir de la medianoche del sábado, en relación con la visita de Witkoff y Kushner a la capital ucraniana. Putin señaló en sus comentarios iniciales que la intensidad de los ataques ucranianos contra Rusia también ha disminuido y prometió garantizar la seguridad de los negociadores estadounidenses. Afirmó que Rusia aún no había aceptado un alto el fuego más amplio de tres días. El presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, declaró que había hablado con los dos enviados estadounidenses que tenían previsto visitar Ucrania el domingo, y añadió que Ucrania estaba dispuesta a abstenerse de lanzar ataques contra Moscú hasta el lunes. UNA ENORME DISTANCIA ENTRE LAS POSTURAS El Ministerio de Defensa ruso informó de la presencia de 53 drones ucranianos en el espacio aéreo ruso el sábado, una cifra significativamente inferior a la media registrada en los últimos meses. Moscú celebra este sábado el Día de la Ciudad, con cientos de miles de personas participando en festividades al aire libre por toda la ciudad. Sigue existiendo un enorme abismo entre Rusia y Ucrania sobre cómo poner fin a la guerra, la más mortífera en Europa desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Una fuente cercana al Kremlin, que habló antes de que surgieran las noticias sobre un posible viaje de los enviados de Trump, afirmó que Putin seguía decidido a conquistar más territorio. "No hay ninguna posibilidad de llegar a un acuerdo sobre la línea del frente hasta que Putin termine de asegurar la parte restante de la región de Donetsk", declaró la fuente a Reuters, añadiendo que el líder del Kremlin confiaba —basándose en los informes de sus comandantes— en que esto ocurriría antes de que acabara el año. LA POSTURA DEL KREMLIN ES «INQUEBRANTABLE» Los analistas militares occidentales consideran que esa posibilidad es remota, dado el lento ritmo de avance de Moscú. Ucrania se ha negado a ceder el territorio que ha defendido con éxito a un enorme coste, y rechaza tales condiciones por considerarlas equivalentes a una rendición. El Kremlin afirmó el viernes que la postura que Putin expuso en un discurso hace dos años —según la cual Ucrania debería ceder la totalidad del territorio de las cuatro regiones reclamadas por Rusia y abandonar su plan de adherirse a la OTAN— era "inquebrantable". Desde las últimas negociaciones de paz en febrero, ambas partes han intensificado los ataques aéreos de largo alcance en lo más profundo del territorio contrario, mientras que la guerra en el mar también se ha recrudecido. Sobre el terreno, las líneas del frente se han mantenido prácticamente estables, y Rusia solo ha logrado avances graduales en su intento de apoderarse de toda la región ucraniana de Donbás. Los ataques con drones de Ucrania contra refinerías de petróleo rusas han provocado un verano de escasez de combustible y subida de precios para los conductores rusos, mientras que unos 30 ataques contra gigantescos almacenes pertenecientes en su mayoría a Wildberries, el mayor minorista en línea del país, han afectado a la economía de consumo.

item.title: Fritz queda eliminado en la tercera ronda del Abierto de Estados Unidos ante Cerúndolo
item.description: El estadounidense Taylor Fritz quedó eliminado el sábado en la tercera ronda del Abierto de Estados Unidos, tras perder ante el argentino Francisco Cerúndolo por 3-6, 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 y 6-4, lo que supone su eliminación más temprana en este torneo de Grand Slam en su país en cuatro años.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: El estadounidense Taylor Fritz quedó eliminado el sábado en la tercera ronda del Abierto de Estados Unidos, tras perder ante el argentino Francisco Cerúndolo por 3-6, 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 y 6-4, lo que supone su eliminación más temprana en este torneo de Grand Slam en su país en cuatro años. Fritz no había cedido ni un solo set en las dos rondas anteriores y parecía uno de los principales candidatos a poner fin a una sequía de 23 años sin que un estadounidense ganara un Grand Slam, pero Cerúndolo sacó lo mejor de sí mismo para alcanzar por primera vez la cuarta ronda del Abierto de Estados Unidos. "No sé cómo he dejado que eso pasara hoy", declaró Fritz con el ceño fruncido a los periodistas en la rueda de prensa posterior al partido. "Jugó mucho mejor que yo en los dos primeros sets", afirmó Cerúndolo, que jugó por primera vez en el estadio Arthur Ashe y ahora se enfrentará al belga Alexander Blockx, quien dio la sorpresa al derrotar al italiano Flavio Cobolli. "Empecé a meterme en el partido poco a poco y creo que en el cuarto y el quinto set jugué muy bien al tenis. No había encontrado ese nivel en los sets anteriores, ni en las rondas anteriores". Fritz había superado con facilidad su partido de segunda ronda en poco más de 90 minutos y parecía encaminado hacia otra victoria sin complicaciones, salvando 11 de los 13 puntos de break a los que se enfrentó en los dos primeros sets. Pero tras un intercambio de breaks al principio del tercer set, el argentino se plantó firme, y el subcampeón de 2024 parecía exasperado cuando lanzó un golpe torcido más allá de la línea de fondo en un punto de break en el sexto juego. Cerúndolo elevó su nivel mientras Fritz se veía afectado por errores poco habituales en el cuarto set, y el estadounidense golpeó su raqueta contra el muslo tras enviar otro golpe largo en un punto de break en el quinto juego. El argentino hizo que su rival corriera de un lado a otro de la línea de fondo con una serie de potentes golpes de precisión en el noveno juego del último set, donde a Fritz se le rompió el cordón del zapato mientras sacaba con un 15-40 en contra. La breve interrupción no sirvió para frenar el ímpetu de Cerúndolo y Fritz envió la pelota a la red, regalándole a su rival el break en el siguiente punto. El argentino selló la victoria con un magnífico golpe de revés. Fritz fue la última baja entre los favoritos del torneo masculino, quedando ya solo cuatro de los diez primeros cabezas de serie en el cuadro.

item.title: Notebook: Chase Briscoe eyes third straight at Darlington
item.description: Chase Briscoe smiled and conceded he never really had held a specific love for Darlington (S.C.) Raceway, the track nicknamed "Too Tough to Tame." But a 2020 win in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series capped with back-to-back trips to Victory Lane for winning the last two Southern 500s, certainly solidified the historic track as one of his all-time favorites.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chase Briscoe smiled and conceded he never really had held a specific love for Darlington (S.C.) Raceway, the track nicknamed "Too Tough to Tame." But a 2020 win in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series capped with back-to-back trips to Victory Lane for winning the last two Southern 500s, certainly solidified the historic track as one of his all-time favorites. This Sunday, Briscoe can tie NASCAR Hall of Famer Jeff Gordon as the only drivers to win the Southern 500 for three consecutive years. And he's very aware of what a victory in Sunday's Cook Out Southern 500 (5 p.m. ET, USA Network, MRN, SiriusXM NASCAR Radio) would mean -- for prosperity and for his current championship run. "To do that three times in a row would be something really, really special," Briscoe said. "So definitely it's on the radar. One of my favorite races of the year, but certainly, also still aware, just of the situation: you can't wreck trying to win this deal, just with the points and the Chase and everything else." Briscoe led four laps and finished 12th here in the Spring. The driver of the No. 19 Joe Gibbs Racing Toyota goes into this opening race of the 16-driver, 10-race 2026 championship run ranked fifth, 45 points behind leader and JGR teammate Denny Hamlin. He is only 20 points behind second place, Team Penske's Ryan Blaney. "Just something about this place has always just kind of fit my driving style, I guess," Briscoe added. "I think the first time I ran here was like 2018 or ‘19 in the Xfinity car, and I just remember coming here in my first five laps on the racetrack, thinking man, this place is awesome. "Like it just fit how I drive for whatever reason. So, I've always just loved this place and yeah, it's been probably the best track for me statistically in my career, I would say, definitely across the Cup Series. --Reddick ready Tyler Reddick put together one of the most impressive season starts in the sport's recent history -- claiming his first Daytona 500 win and then hoisting trophies at the next two consecutive races. The driver of the No. 45 23XI Racing Toyota has won five times -- a personal single season high -- and at one point held a 129-point advantage over Denny Hamlin 12 races into the season. Among his triumphant early season work was a victory in the Darlington 400-miler -- from pole position.
